R1_001.subject: candidate
R1_001.reason: Readers stretched this code to cover invalid logical inferences and unsupported verdict conclusions where no external facts were actually introduced.
R1_001.name: UNGROUNDED_EXTERNAL_KNOWLEDGE_INCLUSION
R1_001.definition: The agent introduces external facts, entities, dates, or assertions that are not present in the supplied input passages or context during reasoning or summary generation.
R1_001.when_to_use: Use when an agent explicitly introduces and relies upon external facts or entities absent from the provided passages or context.
R1_001.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the agent draws an invalid logical inference from provided text or misinterprets provided statements without introducing outside facts.

R1_002.subject: candidate
R1_002.reason: High disagreement on 21 of 22 traces occurred because readers applied this code to verdict contradictions rather than explicit reading misstatements.
R1_002.name: MISREADING_OR_MISINTERPRETING_INPUT_MATERIAL
R1_002.definition: The agent misinterprets, reverses, or distorts factual statements, relationships, negations, or entities explicitly supplied in the input material.
R1_002.when_to_use: Use when an agent incorrectly reads or distorts explicit facts, relationships, or attributes present in the input text.
R1_002.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the agent introduces completely absent external facts or renders an inconsistent overall verdict despite correctly reading the passages.

R1_003.subject: candidate
R1_003.reason: Readers stretched the code to include domain-level reasoning topic shifts rather than structural and functional output non-conformance.
R1_003.name: NON_CONFORMING_TASK_STEP_OUTPUT
R1_003.definition: The agent produces output whose format or functional type fails to conform to the specific output requirements designated for the current execution step.
R1_003.when_to_use: Use when an agent emits narrative summaries, conversational questions, or meta-analysis in an output field designated for a search query or structured step.
R1_003.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the output structure and type conform to instructions but contain factual or retrieval errors.

R1_004.subject: candidate
R1_004.reason: High disagreement (37 of 22 traces) resulted from readers stretching the code to query style preferences and upstream entity identification errors.
R1_004.name: REDUNDANT_OR_MISDIRECTED_QUERY_GENERATION
R1_004.definition: The agent constructs search queries that repeat prior searches, query prompt metadata/already provided passages, or target facts already established in prior turns.
R1_004.when_to_use: Use when an agent formulates queries targeting information already established in context or asking about prompt/retrieval instructions.
R1_004.when_not_to_use: Do not use when a query fails due to upstream misinterpretation of entities or when retrieved passages are irrelevant due to retriever performance.

R1_008.subject: candidate
R1_008.reason: The code combines structural omission of required fields at the general edge with domain-level decisions to prematurely halt task execution.
R1_008.name: MISSING_REQUIRED_OUTPUT_FIELD
R1_008.definition: The agent produces an output that omits one or more contractually required output fields.
R1_008.when_to_use: Use when an output completely omits or leaves blank a field required by the agent's contract.
R1_008.when_not_to_use: Do not use when all required fields are present but contain inaccurate or malformed content.
